100.description:

10059.name: Portal: Stormwind

10060.description:

Can only be cast on players.

An improved Moonkin Form that grants both Eclipses, any learned Celestial Alignment bonuses, and 10% critical strike chance.

Lasts 20 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this improved Moonkin Form for its duration.

104773.description: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage you take by 25% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

1064.description: Heals the friendly target for 875, then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.

Generate 1 combo point every 1.5 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate 1 additional combo point. Finishing moves restore up to 3 combo points generated over the cap.

107270.description: Spin while kicking in the air, dealing 14 Physical damage over 1.3 sec to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

   1 point  : 8 over 1 sec

   5 points: 24 over 4 sec

108199.description: Shadowy tendrils coil around all enemies within 15 yards of a hostile or friendly target, pulling them to the target's location and Silencing them for 3 sec.

Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Shadow Bolt or Malefic Grasp to deal 25% increased damage.

Maximum 2 charges.

Awards 1 combo point.

Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range.

115203.name: Fortifying Brew

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.

Mana Tea:
Consumes 1 stack of Mana Tea per 0.4 sec to restore 648 Mana.

Can be cast while moving, but movement speed is reduced by 40% while channeling.

116670.description: Causes a surge of invigorating mists, healing the target for 959.
116670.name: Vivify

Renewing Mist: Duration increased by 10 sec.
Rising Sun Kick: Cooldown reduced by 9 sec.

117216.description:

117313.description: Bloodthirst heals the Warrior for 3% of their health.
117313.name: Bloodthirst Heal

117418.description: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 456 Physical damage to your primary target and 274 damage to all other enemies over 3.6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.
117418.name: Fists of Fury

Each time you are hit by a melee attack, or hit with Blackout Kick, you gain stacking 18.9% increased Dodge chance until your next successful Dodge.

117952.description: Channel Jade lightning, causing 9 Nature damage over 3.6 sec to the target and sometimes knocking back melee attackers.
117952.name: Crackling Jade Lightning

118038.description: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
118038.name: Die by the Sword

118779.description:

Only usable within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.
118779.name: Victory Rush

119381.description: Knocks down all enemies within 6 yards, stunning them for 3 sec.
119381.name: Leg Sweep

119582.description: Clears 50% of your Staggered damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health.
119582.name: Purifying Brew

119611.description:

If Renewing Mist heals a target past maximum health, it will travel to another injured ally within 20 yds.
119611.name: Renewing Mist

Commands your demon to perform its most powerful ability. This spell will transform based on your active pet. 

Felhunter: Spell Lock
Voidwalker: Shadow Bulwark
Incubus/Succubus: Seduction
Imp: Singe Magic

120146.name: Ancient Portal: Dalaran

12051.description: Increases your mana regeneration by 1,500% for 2.7 sec.
12051.name: Evocation

120644.description: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 603 and dealing 560 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.
120644.name: Halo

120679.description: Damage from your bleed effects has a 4% chance of attracting a powerful wild beast that attacks your target for 8 sec.
120679.name: Dire Beast

121183.description: Allows you a moment of peace as you kneel in quiet contemplation to ponder the nature of the Light.
121183.name: Contemplation

121253.description: Smash a keg of brew, dealing 98 Physical damage to your primary target and 67 Physical damage to all other enemies within 8 yds, and reducing their movement speed by 20% for 15 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

1213597.name: Perfectly-Honed Instincts

Incinerate has a 25% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.

1 set or better: Add 20% increased chance to gain Opportunity.

2 sets or better: Add increased combo point generation.

3 sets or better: Add 30% bonus to Restless Blades' effect.

Jackpot: Add 10% increased critical strike chance.

1215241.description:
Your healing is increased by 10% while Apotheosis is active.

Casting Apotheosis causes your next 3 Prayer of Healing casts to be instant and heal for 25% more.

1215245.name: Eternal Sanctity

121536.name: Angelic Feather

Consume generates a Soul Fragment.
1215617.name: Predator's Thirst

1216953.name: Freezing Winds

Casting Barkskin sprouts thorns on you for 12 sec. When victim to melee attacks, thorns deals 433 Nature damage back to the attacker.

Attackers also have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 4 sec.
1217017.name: Thorns

1217092.description:
Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift, Gust of Wind, Wind Shear, and Nature Totems by 1.0 sec.

Interrupt duration reduced by 65% on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning casts.
1217092.name: Storm Conduit

1217102.description: Trueshot and Volley increase the range of all shots by 30% for their duration.
1217102.name: Sniper's Advantage

Hold to increase lunge distance.
1217413.name: Slicing Winds

1217474.description:
Wrath, Starfire, Cyclone, and Combo-Point generating abilities extend the duration of your active heal over time effects by 1.0 sec on up to 3 allies.

Starsurge and Combo-Point spending abilities increase the rate of your heal over time spells by 20% for 4 sec.
1217474.name: Forest Guardian

1217524.description: When summoned, Dire Beasts gain Beast Cleave at 100% effectiveness for 8.0 sec.
1217524.name: Dire Cleave

1217622.description: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.
1217622.name: Therazane's Resilience

1217941.description: Efflorescence healing increased by 25%, and it now automatically grows beneath your Lifebloom target's feet.
1217941.name: Lifetreading

1218047.description:
Sundering transforms into a single use Primordial Storm for 15 sec after it is cast.

Primordial Storm
Devastate nearby enemies with a Primordial Storm dealing 42 Flamestrike, 41 Froststrike, 41 Stormstrike damage, and unleashing a Lightning Bolt or a Chain Lightning at 150% effectiveness. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Consumes Maelstrom Weapon for increased damage.
1218047.name: Primordial Storm

121817.description:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

Every 15 sec, your next Tiger Palm also casts Expel Harm.

 Expel Harm
Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 453 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.
121817.name: Combat Wisdom

1218211.description: Casting Evangelism increases your damage, and the damage of all allies with your Atonement by 10% for 12 sec.
1218211.name: Dark Archangel

1218447.description: Fire Breath deals its damage 20% more often.
1218447.name: Fulminous Roar

1218603.description:
Pillar of Frost grants you Remorseless Winter and increases its damage by 400% and its radius by 150%, but your movement speed is heavily reduced for its duration.

Pillar of Frost's cooldown is increased by 15 sec.
1218603.name: Death's Cold Embrace

1218692.description: Your Healthstones are replaced with Bloodstones which increase their user's haste by 20% for 12 sec instead of healing.
1218692.name: Bloodstones

1219122.description: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.
1219122.name: Preemptive Maneuver

1219162.description: Aimed Shot may be cast while moving during Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Cheetah's delayed effect is increased by 4 sec.
1219162.name: Aspect of the Fox

1219165.description: Colossus Smash causes your next Mortal Strike to deal 15% increased damage and reduce healing taken by 50% for 4 sec.
1219165.name: Sharpen Blade

1219616.description:
Replaces Call Pet
Gain the aid of a Spotting Eagle. 

Damaging an enemy with an ability empowered by Precise Shots has a 30% chance to cause your Spotting Eagle to rapidly descend from the skies and mark your primary target.

 Spotter's Mark
Your next Aimed Shot deals 20% increased damage to this target.
1219616.name: Spotter's Mark

1219723.description: Disintegrate deals damage 25% more often, but deals 10% less damage.
1219723.name: Azure Celerity

122.description: Blasts enemies within 12 yds of you for 20 Frost damage and freezes them in place for 6 sec. Damage may interrupt the freeze effect.
122.name: Frost Nova

1220506.description: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.
1220506.name: Screaming Brutality

1220739.description:
Your barriers absorb 100% more damage and have an additional effect, but last 4 sec.

 Prismatic Barrier
If the barrier is fully absorbed, your next Blink or Shimmer within 15 sec grants Invisibility and immunity to damage for 3 sec. The damage reduction is lost if Invisibility ends.
1220739.name: Overpowered Barrier

1221167.description:
While in Void Metamorphosis, every 30 Soul Fragments harvested grants access to Collapsing Star.

 Collapsing Star
Channel an immense amount of void energy into a single, cataclysmic blast, dealing 2,121 Cosmic damage to your target and 1,610 Cosmic damage to all nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While casting Collapsing Star, your Fury drain is significantly reduced.
1221167.name: Collapsing Star

122280.description:
You consume a healing elixir when you drop below 40% health or generate excess healing elixirs, instantly healing you for 15% of your maximum health.

You generate 1 healing elixir every 30 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
122280.name: Healing Elixir

1223171.description: The cast range of Voidblade, Consume Magic, and Disrupt are increased by 20 yds.
1223171.name: Guile

1223323.description:
Regain access to Call Pet.

While outdoors, your pet deals 15% increased damage and takes 15% reduced damage.
1223323.name: Unbreakable Bond

1223798.description: Upon reaching maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, your next Arcane Barrage deals 25% increased damage.
1223798.name: Intuition

1223918.description: Damage from Void Ray has a 200% increased chance to generate a Soul Fragment.
1223918.name: Waste Not

1226019.description:
Cut a hole in the fabric of reality, sending a concentrated bolt of cosmic matter towards your target, dealing 2,558 Cosmic damage.

Reap gathers up to 4 nearby souls.
1226019.name: Reap

1226033.description:
Fully channeling Void Ray upgrades your Reap to Eradicate.

 Eradicate
Slam your Scythe to the ground, dealing 2,558 Cosmic damage to your primary target and 2,558 to all other enemies within a 25 yd cone in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Eradicate gathers up to 4 nearby souls.
1226033.name: Eradicate

1226140.description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth summons a Treant that casts Nourish on that target or a nearby ally periodically, healing for 234. Lasts 8 sec.
1226140.name: Grove Guardians

1227280.description:
Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing 260 Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.
1227280.name: Tentacle Slam

1227619.description:
Damaging an enemy has a 4% chance to shatter a lesser soul fragment from them.

 Soul Fragment:
A fragment of your enemy's soul. Walking into the soul or casting Reap will collect it, granting you 4 Fury and healing you for 1% of your maximum health.
1227619.name: Shattered Souls

1227707.description: Each Collapsing Star you cast increases the damage of your next Collapsing Star by 30%.
1227707.name: Impending Apocalypse

1227751.description: Berserker Shout also reduces the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 12 yds.
1227751.name: Berserker Roar

1228516.description: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.
1228516.name: Subservient Shadows

1229376.description:
Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.

The global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.
1229376.name: Single-Button Assistant

12294.description: A vicious strike that deals 183 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.
12294.name: Mortal Strike

1230153.description:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.
1230153.name: Killing Streak

1230223.description: Rime empowered Howling Blast unleashes 2 icy blades at its target that deal 8 Frost damage and have 15% chance to grant Killing Machine.
1230223.name: Howling Blades

1230272.description:
Frost Strike and Glacial Advance now cause your next Frost Strike and Glacial Advance to deal 15% increased damage and cost 5 more Runic Power. 

This effect stacks until the next Runic Empowerment.
1230272.name: Icy Onslaught

1230284.description:
Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. 

Rime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.
1230284.name: Northwinds

1230301.description:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing 72 Shadowfrost damage to both foes.
1230301.name: Frostreaper

1230339.description:
Casting Voidform summons a Mindbender for 10 sec.

 Mindbender
Summons a shadowy fiend to attack your target.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Mindbender attacks.
1230339.name: Mindbender

1231346.description:
Casting Shadow Word: Madness increases the duration of Voidform by 3.0 sec.

Each time this occurs during Voidform, its effectiveness is reduced by 25%.
1231346.name: Ancient Madness

12323.description:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.
12323.name: Piercing Howl

1232616.description:
Beacon of Faith:
Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for 125 every 3 sec.

 Beacon of Virtue:
Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for 1,484.
1232616.name: Pillars of Light

1232739.description:
Dire Beasts will now obey your Kill Command, dealing its damage at 30% effectiveness.

Bestial Wrath now sends your Dire Beasts into a rage, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for 15 sec. Dire Beasts summoned during a Bestial Wrath will benefit at a reduced duration.
1232739.name: Wildspeaker

1232897.description:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction
1232897.name: Lycara's Inspiration

1232955.description: The damage bonus of Precise Shots is increased by an additional 10%.
1232955.name: Unmatched Precision

1233429.description: You sacrifice 1% of your health every 1 sec and in exchange you cannot be slowed below 90% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks. Lasts until canceled.
1233429.name: Price of Progress

1233448.description:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
1233448.name: Dark Transformation

1234195.description: Unleash an eruption of void energy, dealing 106 Cosmic damage and stunning your target and all nearby enemies for 2 sec.
1234195.name: Void Nova

1234559.description: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
1234559.name: Desecrate

1234791.description:
Second Wind reduces damage taken by 10% to 40%, with larger attacks being reduced by more.

While Shield Wall is active, healing reductions do not apply to you.
1234791.name: Power Through Adversity

1234796.description: Shift through the void, reappearing at your targeted destination.
1234796.name: Shift

1235022.description: Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.
1235022.name: Hunker Down

1235023.description: You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.
1235023.name: Spellbreaker

1235047.description: Defensive Stance reduces damage taken by an additional 4%.
1235047.name: Unyielding Stance

1235088.description: Execute hits up to 2 additional targets for 70% damage.
1235088.name: Heavy Handed

1235091.description: Sigil of Misery has 2 charges and now lays in wait for up to 90 sec at your selected location until an enemy approaches.
1235091.name: Lay In Wait

1235113.description: Your attacks have a chance to target a nearby enemy with Ravager for 4 sec.
1235113.name: Whirling Blade

1235211.description: Mind Blast deals 150% increased damage, but costs 40% more mana.
1235211.name: Shadow Tap

1235397.description:
Bleak Powder now applies Black Arrow's periodic effect to all enemies it damages.

If Bleak Powder damages 2 or more enemies, gain Beast Cleave if talented.
1235397.name: Umbral Reach

123586.description:
Soar forward through the air at high speed for 1.5 sec.
 
If used again while active, you will land, reducing the movement speed of enemies within 8 yds by 70% for 4 sec.
123586.name: Flying Serpent Kick

1237270.description: Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
1237270.name: Feast of Souls

1237978.description: Bronze healing and absorption increased by 15%.
1237978.name: Tempo Charged

1238488.description: After fully channeling Void Ray, the cooldown of Reap is reset and your next Reap will collect up to 6 additional Soul Fragments.
1238488.name: Moment of Craving

1238680.description: Consuming Rime reduces the cooldown of Empower Rune Weapon by 6 sec.
1238680.name: Frostbound Will

1238739.description: Each Soul Fragment gathered by Reap increases its damage by 8%.
1238739.name: Soulshaper

1238900.description: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%
1238900.name: Grave Mastery

123904.description: Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 8 Nature damage.
123904.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger

1239519.description:
After dealing damage with The Hunt or Voidblade, Voidblade is replaced with Hungering Slash for 6 sec.

 Hungering Slash
Violently slash your scythe around you, dealing 940 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies and generating 10 Fury. Shatters up to 2 Soul Fragments from nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hungering Slash grants a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat and causes your next Vengeful Retreat within 6 sec to deal an additional 570 Cosmic damage.
1239519.name: Hungering Slash

1239581.description: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.
1239581.name: Unshakable

1239669.description:
You may draw the sun and moon into alignment for 15 sec, empowering either your Nature or Arcane spells. Casting Wrath or Starfire changes what mode of Eclipse will be entered, and the two modes of Eclipse share a button and 32 sec cooldown.

 Eclipse (Solar)
Nature spells deal 15% additional damage and Wrath damage is increased by 40%.

 Eclipse (Lunar)
Arcane spells deal 15% additional damage and Starfire damage is increased by 40%.
1239669.name: Eclipse

123986.description:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 75 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.
123986.name: Chi Burst

1240185.description: Moonfire, Sunfire, and Shooting Stars damage increased by 8%.
1240185.name: Celestial Fire

1240188.description: The cooldowns of Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse are reduced by 2 sec.
1240188.name: Sculpt the Stars

1240189.description: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.
1240189.name: Master Summoner

1240201.description: Damage from Voidblade and the Hunt increases the damage your target takes from you by 12% for 10 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
1240201.name: Devourer's Bite

1240202.description: After fully channeling Void Ray, gain 10 Fury.
1240202.name: Voidglare Boon

1240203.description: Void Ray deals 80% more damage when damaging 3 targets.
1240203.name: Focused Ray

1240204.description: Collapsing Star now generates 3 Soul Fragments.
1240204.name: Star Fragments

1240206.description: Entering any Eclipse has a 10% chance to grant the benefits of both Lunar and Solar Eclipse.
1240206.name: Total Eclipse

1240283.description: When you exit Eclipse with less than 40 Astral Power, Wrath and Starfire's cast times are reduced by 20% for 15 sec or until you enter an Eclipse.
1240283.name: Elune's Challenge

1240364.description: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.
1240364.name: Death's Torment

1240388.description: Increases the chance for Shadowy Insight to occur by 25%. When consuming Shadowy Insight, Mind Blast generates 1 additional Insanity.
1240388.name: Dark Thoughts

1240394.description: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 50% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.
1240394.name: Madness Weaving

1240906.description: Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse have one additional charge.
1240906.name: Improved Eclipse

1240907.description: Every time Starfall drops a wave of stars, a meteorite also falls on up to 2 targets in its range, each dealing 86 Astral damage.
1240907.name: Meteorites

1241059.description: A strong herbal brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 794 total.
1241059.name: Celestial Infusion

1241097.description: Healing Spheres now heal over 10 sec, and their healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.
1241097.name: Niuzao's Resolve

1241136.description: The effectiveness of your Stagger is increased by up to 15%, based on your missing health.
1241136.name: Zen State

1241352.description: Verdant Embrace wreathes you in arcane energy, preventing the next full loss of control effect against you. Lasts 3 sec.
1241352.name: Nullifying Shroud

1241358.description: Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.
1241358.name: Empyrean Legacy

1241462.description:
A pulse of Arcane magic erupts from underneath your target, dealing 370 Arcane damage to all enemies within 2 yds. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Each Arcane Charge increases damage by 84%, radius by 2 yds, and mana cost by 100%.

Generates 1 Arcane Charge.
1241462.name: Arcane Pulse

1241511.description:
Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec.

Avenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 30.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 3.0 sec.
1241511.name: Call of the Righteous

1241542.description: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 100% effectiveness.
1241542.name: Ringing of the Heavens

1241567.description:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 20% reduced damage.
1241567.name: Clawing Shadows

1241669.description: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 30%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.
1241669.name: Dream Simulacrum

1241704.description: Verdant Embrace gains an additional charge.
1241704.name: Wings of Liberty

1241705.description:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 24 Shadow damage to the target and 16 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
1241705.name: Outnumber

1241714.description: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.
1241714.name: Seraphic Barrier

1241805.description: While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 1% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 5%.
1241805.name: Glistening Radiance

1241858.description:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
1241858.name: Unholy Devotion

1241937.description: Light your soul aflame, healing yourself for 24% of your maximum health, generating 30 Fury and shattering 3 Soul Fragments over 5 sec.
1241937.name: Soul Immolation

1241945.description: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.
1241945.name: Blessing of Dusk

1241958.description: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.
1241958.name: Vengeful Wrath

1242008.description: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next 2 Holy Lights to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.
1242008.name: Hand of Divinity

1242031.description: Casting Emerald Blossom causes your next Echo to cast on an additional ally within 25 yards at 100% effectiveness. Stacks up to 2 charges.
1242031.name: Twin Echoes

1242147.description:
Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec.

The Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.
1242147.name: Summon Gargoyle

1242158.description:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 77 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 24 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 33 Shadow damage and 13 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
1242158.name: Forbidden Knowledge

1242492.description: Every soul consumed in Void Metamorphosis grants 0.25% haste, up to 25%.
1242492.name: Emptiness

1242495.description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 240% damage instead of the usual 200%.
1242495.name: Calamitous

1242604.description:
Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 50% effectiveness.

Clawing Shadows can now stack 1 additional times.
1242604.name: Scourging

1242608.description: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing 12 Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.
1242608.name: Raise Abomination

1242745.description: Casting Dream Flight or Stasis increases your healing over time by 60% and causes Living Flame and Reversion to have a 100% increased chance to grant Essence Burst. Lasts 15 sec.
1242745.name: Inner Flame

1242768.description: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.
1242768.name: Sweet Release

1242779.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadowy Apparitions by 10% and their critical strike damage by 40%.
1242779.name: Phantom Menace

124280.description: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.
124280.name: Touch of Karma

1242862.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.
1242862.name: Instilled Doubt

1242910.description: Thunder Focus Tea summons a Jade Serpent Statue at your location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.
1242910.name: Jade Infusion

1243155.description: Vivify healing increased by 15% and Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 30%.
1243155.name: Way of the Serpent

1243287.description: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.
1243287.name: Diffuse Magic

1243307.description: Arcane Missiles now damages 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
1243307.name: Aether Attunement

1243418.description:
Your healing has a chance to coalesces a Healing Sphere out of the mists at your target's location after 1.5 sec. If allies walk through it, they consume the sphere, healing themselves for 1,667 and dispelling all harmful periodic magic effects.

Maximum of 3 Healing Spheres can be active by the Monk at any given time.
1243418.name: Healing Spheres

1243435.description:
Casting Arcane Orb while you have Clearcasting causes you to fire 2 additional Arcane Orbs at 100% effectiveness.

Casting Arcane Orb now consumes Clearcasting.
1243435.name: Orb Mastery

1243507.description: Casting Touch of the Magi grants Clearcasting.
1243507.name: Aegwynn's Technique

1243542.description: The damage of Arcane Blast and Arcane Pulse are increased by 15%, but their mana costs are increased by 25%.
1243542.name: Overflowing Insight

1243554.description:
Soothing Mist, Crackling Jade Lightning, and Rising Sun Kick form a sphere of Hope or Despair above their targets. Only one of each sphere can be active at a time.

 Sphere of Hope: Increases your healing done to the target by 10%.
 Sphere of Despair: Target deals 3% less damage and takes 10% increased damage from all sources.
1243554.name: Zen Spheres

1243557.description:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse grants 2 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Arcane Orb grants 2 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
1243557.name: Expanded Mind

1243659.description: Activating Shield Wall increases your maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.
1243659.name: Last Stand

1243660.description: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.
1243660.name: Resonant Voice

1243807.description:
Unleash a furious frenzy, flickering to nearby targets in front of you 5 times and clawing all enemies around them for 5 Physical damage and an additional 37 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Awards 5 combo points.
1243807.name: Frantic Frenzy

1244001.description:
Arcane Salvo damage bonus increased by 2%.

 Arcane Salvo:
Increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 3%.
1244001.name: Arcane Singularity

1244019.description: You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by Refining Fire.
1244019.name: Undying Embers

1244025.description: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
1244025.name: Improved Conjuration

1244069.description: Ice Barrier reduces your physical damage taken by 10% and absorbs an additional 5% of your maximum health.
1244069.name: Improved Ice Barrier

1244070.description: Casting Avenger's Shield causes Consecration to deal its damage and healing again immediately at 100% effectiveness.
1244070.name: Searing Sunlight

1244087.description: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.
1244087.name: Time Walk

1244088.description: Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least 6,110 damage from this effect.
1244088.name: Interpose

1244090.description: Upon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 50% of your maximum health.
1244090.name: Temporal Realignment

1244105.description: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
1244105.name: Charm of Aegwynn

1244110.description: Ice Block and Ice Barrier now have an additional charge.
1244110.name: Glacial Bulwark

1244220.description: Void Ray's cooldown during Void Metamorphosis is reduced by 2.0 sec.
1244220.name: Voidpurge

1244222.description: Reap and Consume damage increased by 10%.
1244222.name: Devourer's Edge

1244237.description: When Void Metamorphosis expires, for each unused Soul you harvested, gain 5 Fury and increase your damage by 0.50% for 12 sec.
1244237.name: Rolling Torment

1244258.description:
Chomp your target, causing 317 Physical damage. Chomp critical strikes deal 3 times normal damage.

Chomp can only be used when you fall below 30% Energy or for 2 seconds afterward.
1244258.name: Chomp

1244295.description:
The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 1 sec.

 Feast of Souls
Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
1244295.name: Sweet Suffering

1244310.description:
Increases Conflagrate damage by 10%. 

Conflagrate now erupts the target's Immolate, spreading it up to 3 nearby enemies.
1244310.name: Roaring Blaze

1244329.description: Gaining Clearcasting has a 25% chance to cause your next Arcane Missiles to be Overpowered, causing it to deal 100% increased damage, generate maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, and strike 3 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
1244329.name: Overpowered Missiles

1244340.description: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.
1244340.name: Improved Blink

1244460.description: Increases the duration of Havoc by 5 sec and increases the damage Havoc victims are dealt by an additional 10%.
1244460.name: Improved Havoc

1244532.description: Ferocious Bite's damage to its primary target increased by 2% for each enemy affected by your Rip, up to 10.
1244532.name: Blood Spattered

1244544.description: Feral Frenzy's cooldown reduced by 15 sec and its damage is increased by 20%.
1244544.name: Focused Frenzy

1244547.description: When an enemy afflicted by your Rip dies, gain 10 Energy and your damage dealt is increased by 5% for 8 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
1244547.name: Hunger for Battle

434028.name: Vampiric Speed

434033.description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 5% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
434033.name: Blood-Soaked Ground

434075.description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
434075.name: Frenzied Bloodthirst

434100.description:
Your Leech is increased by 2%.

While Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.
434100.name: Vampiric Aura

434136.description:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
434136.name: Bloody Fortitude

434143.description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
434143.name: Infliction of Sorrow

434151.description:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
434151.name: Incite Terror

434152.description:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
434152.name: Gift of the San'layn

434157.description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
434157.name: Visceral Strength

434249.description:
Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.

Affects Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment, and Convoke the Spirits.
434249.name: Control of the Dream

434260.description:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 25% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
434260.name: The Blood is Life

434261.description: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
434261.name: Pact of the San'layn

434263.description: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
434263.name: Sanguine Scent

434300.description:
Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.

You and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.
434300.name: Bombardments

434774.description: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.
434774.name: Transcendence: Linked Spirits

434905.description:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.
434905.name: Grim Reaper

434969.description:
Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.

Lightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.
434969.name: Lightning Strikes

434970.description:
Stamina increased by 5%.

Victory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.
434970.name: Steadfast as the Peaks

435005.description:
Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. 

This amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.
435005.name: Smothering Offense

435010.description: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice dealing 37 Frost damage to enemies in front of you.
435010.name: Icy Death Torrent

435607.description:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 67 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.
435607.name: Thunder Blast

436148.description: Lightning Strikes also deal 15 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
436148.name: Ground Current

436152.description:
Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.

Raging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.
436152.name: Thorim's Might

436162.description: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.
436162.name: Storm Bolts

436201.description: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.
436201.name: Gathering Clouds

436335.description: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
436335.name: Mass Disintegrate

436358.description:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 802 damage to it, and 430 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.
436358.name: Demolish

436687.description:
Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.

Runic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.
436687.name: Dark Talons

436707.description:
Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.

Thunder Clap damage increased by 30%.
436707.name: Crashing Thunder

437068.description:
Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.

Bloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.
437068.name: Strength of the Mountain

437079.description: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.
437079.name: Flashing Skies

437118.description: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.
437118.name: Burst of Power

437122.description: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.
437122.name: Death's Messenger

437134.description:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.
437134.name: Avatar of the Storm

437161.description: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.
437161.name: Soul Rupture

438439.description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick deal an additional 400% damage.
438439.name: Dance of Chi-Ji

438587.description: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
438587.name: Mass Eruption

438590.description:
Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.

Thunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.
438590.name: Keep Your Feet on the Ground

438597.description: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.
438597.name: Storm Shield

439528.description:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.
439528.name: Thriving Growth

439760.description:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.
439760.name: Aurora

439843.description:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 109 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 14 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.
439843.name: Reaper's Mark

439851.description:
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 34 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.
439851.name: Wave of Souls

439868.description:
Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.

Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.
439868.name: Hunt Beneath the Open Skies

439880.description:
Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.

When a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.
439880.name: Resilient Flourishing

439882.description:
Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.

Each active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.
439882.name: Root Network

439890.description:
Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.

Your periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.
439890.name: Strategic Infusion

439895.description: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
439895.name: Entangling Vortex

439901.description: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.
439901.name: Flower Walk

439926.description:
Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.

Rejuvenation healing increased by 10%.
439926.name: Wildstalker's Power

439929.description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.
439929.name: Bond with Nature

439948.description: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.
439948.name: Expelling Shield

440006.description: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.
440006.name: Purify Disease

440012.description: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.
440012.name: Cleanse Spirit

440013.description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects..
440013.name: Cleanse Toxins

440015.description: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.
440015.name: Remove Corruption

440031.description:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
440031.name: Bind in Darkness

440040.description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
440040.name: Xalan's Cruelty

440043.description:
Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells will further corrupt enemies affected by your Wither, increasing its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 378 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
440043.name: Blackened Soul

440044.description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
440044.name: Xalan's Ferocity

440045.description:
Critical strike damage dealt by Wither is increased by 10%. 

Wither has a chance to gain a stack when it critically strikes. Stacks gained this way do not activate Blackened Soul.
440045.name: Mark of Peroth'arn

440046.description:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
440046.name: Mark of Xavius

440048.description: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
440048.name: Hatefury Rituals

440051.description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
440051.name: Bleakheart Tactics

440055.description:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 378 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
440055.name: Seeds of Their Demise

440057.description:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
440057.name: Curse of the Satyr

440059.description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
440059.name: Aura of Enfeeblement

440065.description: Dark Pact heals you for 625 every 1 sec while active.
440065.name: Zevrim's Resilience

440070.description: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
440070.name: Illhoof's Design

440116.description: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.
440116.name: Harmonious Constitution

440117.description: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.
440117.name: Twin Sprouts

440118.description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.
440118.name: Implant

440119.description:
Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.

Symbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.
440119.name: Vigorous Creepers

440120.description:
When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

When Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 160.
440120.name: Bursting Growth

440277.description: Enrage increases your mastery by 15% and your Leech by 3%.
440277.name: Powerful Enrage

440282.description: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.
440282.name: Rune Carved Plates

440476.description:
When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.

When a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.
440476.name: Pact of the Deathbringer

440662.description:
Increases the healing done by Prayer of Mending by 15%.

All damage dealt by Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Nova increased by 40%.
440662.name: Preventive Measures

440669.description: For 6 sec after casting Leap of Faith you may cast it a second time for free, ignoring its cooldown.
440669.name: Save the Day

440670.description:
Your Angelic Feathers increase movement speed by an additional 10%.

When an ally walks through your Angelic Feather, you are also granted 100% of its effect.
440670.name: Divine Feathers

440671.description: Increases the duration of your Renew by 40%.
440671.name: Preemptive Care

440681.description: Reduces the cooldown of Prayer of Mending by 1.5 sec.
440681.name: Waste No Time

440738.description: Guardian Spirit lasts an additional 2 sec.
440738.name: Foreseen Circumstances

440742.description: 3 additional Penance bolts are fired at an enemy within 40 yards when healing an ally with Penance, or fired at an ally within 40 yards when damaging an enemy with Penance.
440742.name: Twinsight

440766.description:
Casting Prayer of Mending applies Power Word: Shield to your target.

 Power Word: Shield
Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,784 damage.
440766.name: Assured Safety

440992.description: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
440992.name: Earthquaker

440993.description:
When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
440993.name: Veteran Vitality

440995.description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.
440995.name: Arterial Bleed

441146.description:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 97 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.
441146.name: Unseen Blade

441176.description:
Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
441176.name: Melt Armor

441180.description: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
441180.name: Hardened Scales

441181.description: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.
441181.name: Menacing Presence

441206.description: Bombardments reduce the cooldown of Deep Breath by 0.5 sec for each target struck, up to 1.5 sec.
441206.name: Wingleader

441212.description: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.
441212.name: Extended Battle

441219.description: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.
441219.name: Diverted Power

441245.description: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.
441245.name: Onslaught

441246.description: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.
441246.name: Unrelenting Siege

441247.description: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
441247.name: Smoke

441250.description: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%
441250.name: Mirrors

441253.description: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.
441253.name: Nimble Flyer

441257.description: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.
441257.name: Slipstream

441263.description: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.
441263.name: Devious Distractions

441273.description: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
441273.name: Surprising Strikes

441274.description: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
441274.name: Disorienting Strikes

441321.description: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
441321.name: Flawless Form

441346.description: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
441346.name: Thousand Cuts

441359.description:
Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
441359.name: Flickerstrike

441367.description: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.
441367.name: Nimble Flurry

441378.description:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.

The first scythe strikes your target for 186 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 75 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
441378.name: Exterminate

441398.description: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.
441398.name: No Scruples

441403.description: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.
441403.name: So Tricky

441415.description:
Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.

Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.
441415.name: Don't Be Suspicious

441423.description: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
441423.name: Coup de Grace

441429.description:
Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.

Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
441429.name: Cloud Cover

441583.description:
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: 13 damage, 6 in an arc
2 points: 27 damage, 12 in an arc
3 points: 40 damage, 17 in an arc
4 points: 53 damage, 23 in an arc
5 points: 63 damage, 30 in an arc
441583.name: Ravage

441675.description:
Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.

Frenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.
441675.name: Fount of Strength

441678.description:
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.
441678.name: Wildshape Mastery

441689.description:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and Swipe damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.
441689.name: Empowered Shapeshifting

441691.description: Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.
441691.name: Wildpower Surge

441809.description:
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes 35 damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death.
441809.name: Dreadful Wound

441814.description: Ravage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.
441814.name: Ruthless Aggression

441824.description:
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.
441824.name: Killing Strikes

441829.description: Every attack with an Energy cost that you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.
441829.name: Aggravate Wounds

441835.description: During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.
441835.name: Claw Rampage

441841.description: Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.
441841.name: Bestial Strength

441844.description: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.
441844.name: Pack's Endurance

441845.description: Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
441845.name: Strike for the Heart

441846.description: The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.
441846.name: Tear Down the Mighty

441894.description: Frost Fever deals its damage 100% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.
441894.name: Wither Away

442290.description:
Consuming 20 Soul Fragments or casting Sigil of Spite converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive.

 Reaver's Glaive: 
Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 134 Physical damage and ricocheting to 2 additional enemies.
 
Begins a well-practiced pattern of glaivework, enhancing your next Shear and Soul Cleave.

The enhanced ability you cast first deals 10% increased damage, and the second deals 20% increased damage.
442290.name: Art of the Glaive

442502.description: Consuming a Soul Fragment causes your next Shear to deal 21 additional Physical damage.
442502.name: Warblade's Hunger

442679.description:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Shear applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 7% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 2 stacks.

Applies 1 additional stack of Reaver's Mark If cast after Soul Cleave.
442679.name: Reaver's Mark

442683.description: The second enhanced ability in a pattern shatters an additional Soul Fragment.
442683.name: Aldrachi Tactics

442686.description: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.
442686.name: Thrill of the Fight

442687.description:
Teachings of the Monastery has a 15% chance to refund a charge when consumed. 

The damage of Tiger Palm is increased by 10%.
442687.name: Xuen's Guidance

442714.description: Felblade surrounds you with a Blade Ward, reducing damage taken by 10% for 5 sec.
442714.name: Army Unto Oneself

442718.description:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Soul Cleave casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

If cast after Shear, cast 6 slashes instead.
442718.name: Fury of the Aldrachi

442726.description:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
442726.name: Malevolence

442736.description: Each Soul Fragment you consume shields you for an additional 15% of the amount healed.
442736.name: Incorruptible Spirit

442747.description: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.
442747.name: Niuzao's Protection

442806.description: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
442806.name: Wounded Quarry

443028.description:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 387 Nature damage onto enemies and 20,555 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
443028.name: Celestial Conduit

443046.description: Using Wild Charge while in Bear Form or Moonkin Form incurs a 3 sec shorter cooldown.
443046.name: Elune's Grace

443059.description:
You heal for 10% of your maximum health instantly when you activate Celestial Conduit and receive 15% less damage for its duration. 

This effect lingers for an additional 8 sec after Celestial Conduit ends.
443059.name: Jade Sanctuary

443087.description:
Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.

Invoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.
443087.name: Courage of the White Tiger

443177.description: Reversion healing has a chance to cause your next Living Flame to cast instantly and deal 50% increased healing or damage. Stacks up to 2 charges.
443177.name: Lifespark

443264.description: Essence Burst increases the effectiveness of your next Essence ability by 35%.
443264.name: Titan's Gift

443294.description: upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of  by 75% for .
443294.name: Heart of the Jade Serpent

443418.description: Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.
443418.name: Elemental Reverb

443423.description: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.
443423.name: Ancient Fellowship

443425.description: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
443425.name: Spiritwalker's Momentum

443441.description: Earth Shield has an additional 3 charges and heals you for 25% more.
443441.name: Earthen Communion

443442.description: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.
443442.name: Natural Harmony

443445.description: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
443445.name: Routine Communication

443446.description:
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

 Hydrobubble
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 1,795 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.
443446.name: Final Calling

443447.description: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.
443447.name: Maelstrom Supremacy

443448.description:
Increases your maximum mana by 10%.

Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.
443448.name: Primordial Capacity

443449.description: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.
443449.name: Latent Wisdom

443450.description:
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.
443450.name: Call of the Ancestors

443451.description: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.
443451.name: Offering from Beyond

443454.description:
Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.

If you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
443454.name: Ancestral Swiftness

443560.description:
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.
443560.name: Swift and Painful

443566.description: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.
443566.name: Chi-Ji's Swiftness

443571.description:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Crane Stance:
Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery
443571.name: Inner Compass

443589.description:
Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.

Unity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.
443589.name: Unity Within

443625.description: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15%.
443625.name: Yu'lon's Knowledge

443739.description:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse conjures an Arcane Splinter.

Arcane Splinter:
Conjure raw Arcane magic into a sharp projectile that deals 219 Arcane damage.
443739.name: Splintering Sorcery

443783.description:
Casting Arcane Surge generates 8 Arcane Splinters.

During Arcane Surge, your chance to conjure an additional Arcane Splinter is increased to 100%.
443783.name: Splinterstorm

444005.description:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.
444005.name: Rider's Champion

444008.description: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.
444008.name: On a Paler Horse

444010.description:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.
444010.name: Death Charge

444016.description: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.
444016.name: Enkindle

444020.description: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.
444020.name: Burning Adrenaline

444033.description: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.
444033.name: Whitemane's Famine

444037.description: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.
444037.name: Hungering Thirst

444040.description: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.
444040.name: Apocalypse Now

444047.description: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
444047.name: Mograine's Might

444052.description:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.
444052.name: Nazgrim's Conquest

444069.description: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.
444069.name: Fury of the Horsemen

444072.description: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.
444072.name: A Feast of Souls

444074.description:
While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.

You may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.
444074.name: Horsemen's Aid

444083.description: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.
444083.name: Pact of the Apocalypse

444088.description:
Disintegrate damage consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre damage consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.
444088.name: Consume Flame

444097.description: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
444097.name: Trollbane's Icy Fury

444099.description: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.
444099.name: Mawsworn Menace

44425.description:
Launches bolts of arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 361 Arcane damage. 

For each Arcane Charge, deals 107% additional damage.

Consumes all Arcane Charges.
44425.name: Arcane Barrage

444256.description:
Enemies damaged by your Arcane Orb conjure 2 Arcane Splinters, up to 4.

Arcane Orb damage is increased by 10%.
444256.name: Splintering Orbs

444322.description: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.
444322.name: Lifecinders

444483.description: 40% of the direct damage dealt by an Arcane Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
444483.name: Controlled Instincts

444719.description: Casting Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.
444719.name: Force of Will

444752.description: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.
444752.name: Slippery Slinging

444756.description: While in combat, Blink summons a Mirror Image at your previous location.
444756.name: Look Again

444767.description: Your attacks against your primary target have a 15% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 298 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.
444767.name: Slayer's Dominance

444769.description:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.
444769.name: Imminent Demise

444770.description: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
444770.name: Death Drive

444771.description: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
444771.name: Show No Mercy

444772.description: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.
444772.name: Overwhelming Blades

444773.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.
444773.name: Fierce Followthrough

444774.description: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 10% additional damage and 10% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.
444774.name: Opportunist

444775.description: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 272 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
444775.name: Reap the Storm

444776.description:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
444776.name: Relentless Pursuit

444777.description: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
444777.name: Vicious Agility

444778.description: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
444778.name: Culling Cyclone

444779.description: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.
444779.name: Slayer's Malice

444780.description:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

444784.description: Your Mirror Image summons 1 extra clone.
444784.name: Phantasmal Image

444827.description:
Your Prismatic Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing Health.

Max effectiveness when under 25% health.

444843.description: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 15%.
444843.name: Conduit of Flame

444845.description: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 30%.
444845.name: Expanded Lungs

444849.description: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.
444849.name: Trailblazer

444926.description: Vengeful Retreat can be cast a second time within 3 sec.
444926.name: Evasive Action

444931.description: Vengeful Retreat resets the cooldown of Felblade.
444931.name: Unhindered Assault

444968.description:
Arcane Surge damage increased by 30%.

Your chance to gain Clearcasting is increased by 3%.
444968.name: Archmage's Wrath

444986.description: Direct damage from Arcane Splinters reduces the cooldown of Arcane Orb by 0.25 sec.
444986.name: Spellfrost Teachings
