Elemental motes orbit around your Surging Totem. Your abilities consume the motes for enhanced effects. 

Water: Your next Healing Wave also heals an ally inside of your Healing Rain at 50% effectiveness.

Air: The cast time of your next healing spell is reduced by 40%.

Earth: Your next Chain Heal applies Earthliving at 150% effectiveness to all targets hit.
445024.name: Whirling Elements

445025.description: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for 837. Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.
445025.name: Totemic Rebound

445026.description: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.
445026.name: Oversized Totems

445027.description:
Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.
445027.name: Swift Recall

445028.description: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.
445028.name: Imbuement Mastery

445029.description: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.
445029.name: Amplification Core

445030.description: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.
445030.name: Oversurge

445031.description: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 1,833 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.
445031.name: Wind Barrier

445032.description: Increases the healing done by Surging Totem by 25%.
445032.name: Pulse Capacitor

445033.description:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

 Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.
445033.name: Supportive Imbuements

445034.description: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.
445034.name: Lively Totems

445035.description:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.

Healing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.
445035.name: Splitstream

445036.description: Chain Heals from Lively Totem and Totemic Rebound are 25% more effective.
445036.name: Totemic Coordination

445074.description: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.
445074.name: Shape of Flame

445200.description: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.
445200.name: Blessing of An'she

445468.description:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 76 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,259 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
445468.name: Wither

445625.description: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.
445625.name: Titanic Precision

445958.description: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.
445958.name: Draconic Instincts

446085.description: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
446085.name: Brutal Finish

44614.description:
Unleash a flurry of ice, striking the target 3 times for a total of 1,600 Frost damage.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
44614.name: Flurry

446260.description:
Rising Sun Kick now kicks up a Gust of Mist to heal 2 allies within 40 yds for 0. 

Spinning Crane Kick and Blackout Kick have a chance to kick up a Gust of Mist to heal 1 ally within 40 yds for 0.
446260.name: Crane Style

446326.description: Renewing Mist's heal over time has a chance to cause your next Vivify to also trigger a Zen Pulse on its target and all allies with Renewing Mist, healing them for 610 increased by 6% per Renewing Mist active, up to 30%.
446326.name: Zen Pulse

446345.description: After you fully consume Thunder Focus Tea, your next Vivify triggers Zen Pulse.
446345.name: Deep Clarity

446534.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Dornogal.
446534.name: Portal: Dornogal

446663.description:
When Truth's Wake critically strikes, its duration is extended by 2 sec.

Your other damage over time effects deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by Truth's Wake.
446663.name: Burn to Ash

447131.description: Rejuvenation instantly heals your target for 20% of its total periodic effect and Regrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec.
447131.name: Thriving Vegetation

447444.description: Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 223 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.
447444.name: Entropic Rift

447985.description: While above 80% health, Holy Shock's healing is increased 20%, but creates a heal absorb on you for 30% of the amount healed that prevents Beacon of Light from healing you until it has dissipated.
447985.name: Light of the Martyr

448040.description:
Light of the Martyr's health threshold is reduced to 70% and increases Holy Shock's healing by an additional 5% for every 5 sec Light of the Martyr is active, stacking up to 3 times.

While below 70% health, the light urgently heals you for 76 every 1 sec.
448040.name: Bestow Light

448278.description: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.
448278.name: Inner Quietus

448403.description:
Each time Penance damages or heals, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 10%.

After Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 1,672 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.
448403.name: Collapsing Void

448601.description:
Casting a damaging spell has a 12% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.
448601.name: Spellfire Spheres

448658.description:
When you cast Arcane Surge, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

  Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Arcane Surge, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.
448658.name: Invocation: Arcane Phoenix

449182.description:
Stamina increased by 4%.

Stamina in Bear Form is increased by an additional 5%.
449182.name: Ursoc's Spirit

449184.description: Ferocious Bite and Maul damage increased by 8%.
449184.name: Instincts of the Claw

449185.description: Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.
449185.name: Lore of the Grove

449191.description: Survival Instincts and Barkskin reduce damage taken by an additional 10%.
449191.name: Oakskin

449193.description:
Shred, Rake, and Skull Bash can be used in any form and shift you into Cat Form, if necessary. 

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.
449193.name: Fluid Form

449293.description: Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Barrage grants you 0.5% Haste for 10 sec. Stacks up to 10 times. Multiple instances may overlap.
449293.name: Mana Cascade

449330.description: The bonuses provided by your Barrier spells persist an additional 8 sec after your Barrier is removed.
449330.name: Merely a Setback

449349.description: Arcane Barrage deals 5% increased damage to enemies affected by your Touch of the Magi.
449349.name: Sunfury Execution

449382.description:
When your Arcane Phoenix is summoned, it consumes all your Spellfire Spheres.

Each Sphere consumed increases your spell damage during Arcane Surge by 1% and causes your Arcane Phoenix to cast an exceptional Arcane or Fire spell over its duration.
449382.name: Codex of the Sunstriders

449394.description:
Arcane Barrage summons 1 Meteorite for every 6 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 417 Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.
449394.name: Glorious Incandescence

449412.description: When you cast Arcane Surge, its duration is extended by 0.4 sec for each Spellfire Sphere you have, up to 2.0 sec.
449412.name: Savor the Moment

44949.description: Unleashes a whirlwind of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 56 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
44949.name: Whirlwind Off-Hand

449537.description: If you generate a combo point in excess of what you can store, your next Ferocious Bite or Primal Wrath deals 10% increased direct damage.
449537.name: Coiled to Spring

449582.description: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.
449582.name: Lighter Than Air

449596.description: Spellfire Spheres can now stack up to 5 times.
449596.name: Rondurmancy

449614.description:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
449614.name: Demonic Soul

449619.description:
During Arcane Surge, you gain twice as many stacks of Mana Cascade.

When your Arcane Phoenix expires, it empowers you, granting Arcane Soul for 4.0 sec.

Arcane Soul:
Arcane Barrage grants Clearcasting and generates 4 Arcane Charges.

Each cast of Arcane Barrage grants 5 stacks of Arcane Salvo and casting Arcane Barrage does not consume Arcane Salvo.
449619.name: Memory of Al'ar

449620.description: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
449620.name: Necrolyte Teachings

449624.description:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
449624.name: Soul Anathema

449627.description: Your Arcane Phoenix has picked up a few tricks, and will Spellsteal when it is summoned and when it expires.
449627.name: Lessons in Debilitation

449629.description: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
449629.name: Demoniac's Fervor

449631.description:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
449631.name: Wicked Reaping

449634.description:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
449634.name: Quietus

449637.description: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
449637.name: Sataiel's Volition

449638.description: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
449638.name: Shadow of Death

449645.description: Tiger's Fury increases your Haste by 10% and Energy recovery rate by 25% for 8 sec.
449645.name: Savage Fury

449701.description: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
449701.name: Gorebound Fortitude

449703.description: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
449703.name: Friends In Dark Places

449704.description:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 191 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
449704.name: Shared Fate

449706.description: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
449706.name: Feast of Souls

449707.description: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
449707.name: Eternal Servitude

449806.description: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.
449806.name: Divine Halo

449874.description: Halo damage and healing is increased by 30%.
449874.name: Energy Compression

449880.description: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.
449880.name: Voidheart

449912.description: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.
449912.name: Darkening Horizon

450138.description: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.
450138.name: Void Empowerment

450154.description: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.
450154.name: Rushing Reflexes

450212.description: Starsurge increases the damage the target takes from your periodic effects and Shooting Stars by 16% for 5 sec. Reapplying this effect extends its duration, up to 20 sec.
450212.name: Stellar Amplification

450335.description: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.
450335.name: Crashing Momentum

450347.description: When Eclipse ends or when you enter combat, enter a Dreamstate, reducing the cast time of your next 2 Starfires or Wraths by 30%.
450347.name: Nature's Grace

450356.description:
Casting Wrath has a 15% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.

Casting Starfire has a 20% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.
450356.name: Touch the Cosmos

450373.description: Consuming Sentinel's Mark grants you an absorb shield equal to 10.0% of your maximum health.
450373.name: Don't Look Back

450379.description:
Kill Command grants an additional 5 Focus and its damage is increased by 20%. 

Maximum Focus increased by 25.
450379.name: Invigorating Pulse

450405.description:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 567 Shadow damage.
450405.name: Void Blast

450426.description: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.
450426.name: Chi Proficiency

450427.description: Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.
450427.name: Martial Instincts

450432.description: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.
450432.name: Pressure Points

450448.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
450448.name: Peace and Prosperity

450503.description: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.
450503.name: Quick Footed

450508.description:
Store vitality from 10% of your damage dealt and 30% of your healing.

For 10 sec after casting Thunder Focus Tea your spells and abilities draw upon the stored vitality to deal 40% additional healing over 8 sec.
450508.name: Aspect of Harmony

450514.description:
The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.
 
The duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.
450514.name: Wind's Reach

450520.description: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.
450520.name: Bounding Agility

450529.description:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.
450529.name: Coalescence

450553.description: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.
450553.name: Jade Walk

450558.description: Starsurge or Starfall increase your current Eclipse's Arcane or Nature damage bonus by an additional 2%, up to 6%.

Unleash a beam of concentrated void energy, dealing 75 Cosmic damage and consuming 5 Fury every 0.1 sec.

Effect ends after 2.7 sec or upon reaching 0 Fury.
473728.name: Void Ray

474421.description:
Your Spotting Eagle descends from the skies, stunning your target for 5 sec.

This ability does not require line of sight when used against players.
474421.name: Intimidation

474440.description:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Cunning specialization, granting you Master's Call and Pathfinding.

 Master's Call
Your pet removes all root and movement impairing effects from itself and a friendly target, and grants immunity to all such effects for 4 sec.

 Pathfinding
Your movement speed is increased by 8%.
474440.name: Cunning

474456.description:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Tenacity specialization, granting you Endurance Training and Air Superiority.

 Endurance Training
You gain 5% increased maximum health.

 Air Superiority
Your Spotting Eagle alerts you to oncoming danger, reducing all damage you take by 3%
474456.name: Tenacious

474526.description: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.
474526.name: Grievous Wounds

474530.description: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.
474530.name: Circle of the Wild

474541.description: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.
474541.name: Circle of the Heavens

474678.description:
When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.
474678.name: Aessina's Renewal

474738.description: Trueshot now increases your critical strike chance by an additional 10% and increases your critical strike damage by an additional 20%.
474738.name: Unerring Vision

474746.description: Your pet damage is increased by 35% and your pet is 10% larger.
474746.name: Solitary Companion

474750.description: Form a bond with an ally. Your self-healing also heals your bonded ally for 10% of the amount healed. Your healing to your bonded ally also heals you for 8% of the amount healed.
474750.name: Symbiotic Relationship

47476.description: Shadowy tendrils constrict an enemy's throat, silencing them for 4 sec.
47476.name: Strangulate

475.description: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
475.name: Remove Curse

47515.description: Direct critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 30% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.
47515.name: Divine Aegis

47528.description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
47528.name: Mind Freeze

47540.description:
Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 913 Holy damage to an enemy or 4,053 healing to an ally over 1.8 sec. Castable while moving.

When you heal with Penance, everyone with your Atonement is healed for 71.
47540.name: Penance

47541.description:
Fires a blast of unholy energy at the target, causing 74 Shadow damage to an enemy or healing an Undead ally for 165 health.

Extends the duration of Dread Plague and Virulent Plague by 1.5 sec.
47541.name: Death Coil

47568.description: Drain the will of your enemy to empower your rune weapon, dealing 70 Shadowfrost damage and reduced damage to enemies nearby, gaining 40 Runic Power, and grants you Killing Machine.
47568.name: Empower Rune Weapon

47585.description:
Disperse into pure shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 75% for 6 sec and healing you for 25% of your maximum health over its duration, but you are unable to attack or cast spells.

Increases movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to all movement impairing effects.

Castable while stunned, feared, or silenced.
47585.name: Dispersion

47788.description:
Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target for 10 sec, increasing healing received by 60%. If the target would die, the Spirit sacrifices itself and restores the target to 40% health.

Castable while stunned. Cannot save the target from massive damage.
47788.name: Guardian Spirit

48181.description:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing 2,704 Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 12% for 18 sec.

 If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.
48181.name: Haunt

48265.description:
For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

Passive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.
48265.name: Death's Advance

48438.description: Heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 1,085 over 7 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.
48438.name: Wild Growth

48484.description: Rake damage increased by 30%, and Rake causes an Infected Wound in the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 20% for 12 sec.
48484.name: Infected Wounds

48707.description: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to 9,165 magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.
48707.name: Anti-Magic Shell

48743.description: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
48743.name: Death Pact

48792.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
48792.name: Icebound Fortitude

49020.description: A brutal attack that deals 42 Physical and 41 Frost damage.
49020.name: Obliterate

49028.description:
Summons a rune weapon for 8 sec that mirrors your melee attacks and bolsters your defenses.

While active, you gain 25% parry chance.
49028.name: Dancing Rune Weapon

49039.description: Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.
49039.name: Lichborne

49143.description: Chill your weapon with icy power and quickly strike the enemy, dealing 46 Frost damage.
49143.name: Frost Strike

49184.description:
Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing 8 Frost damage to that foe, and reduced damage to all other enemies within 10 yards, infecting all targets with Frost Fever.

 Frost Fever
A disease that deals 59 Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.
49184.name: Howling Blast

49360.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Theramore.
49360.name: Portal: Theramore

49361.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Stonard.
49361.name: Portal: Stonard

49530.description: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
49530.name: Sudden Doom

49576.description: Harnesses the energy that surrounds and binds all matter, drawing the target toward you.
49576.name: Death Grip

498.description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.
498.name: Divine Protection

4987.description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Magic effects.
4987.name: Cleanse

49998.description: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 54 Physical damage and heals you for 20.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.
49998.name: Death Strike

50334.description: Go berserk for 15 sec, reducing the cooldowns of Mangle, Thrash, and Growl by 50% and the cooldown of Frenzied Regeneration by 100%.
50334.name: Berserk

50622.description: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, striking all nearby targets with your main hand weapon for 96 Physical damage.
50622.name: Bladestorm

50769.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Not castable in combat.
50769.name: Revive

50842.description:
Deals 58 Shadow damage and infects all enemies within 10 yds with Blood Plague.

 Blood Plague
A shadowy disease that drains 93 health from the target over 24 sec.
50842.name: Blood Boil

50977.description:
Opens a gate which you can use to return to Ebon Hold.

Using a Death Gate while in Ebon Hold will return you back to near your departure point.
50977.name: Death Gate

51052.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
51052.name: Anti-Magic Zone

51128.description: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to make your next Obliterate deal Frost damage and critically strike, or make your next Frostscythe critically strike for 4 times the normal damage.
51128.name: Killing Machine

5116.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
5116.name: Concussive Shot

51271.description: The power of frost increases your Strength by 30% for 12 sec.
51271.name: Pillar of Frost

5143.description:
Requires Clearcasting
Launches 5 waves of Arcane Missiles at the enemy over 2.2 sec, causing a total of 2,162 Arcane damage.
5143.name: Arcane Missiles

51462.description: Each Runic Power you spend has a 2.0% chance to increase your Rune regeneration rate by 100% for 3 sec.
51462.name: Runic Corruption

51505.description: Hurls molten lava at the target, dealing 525 Fire damage. Lava Burst will always critically strike if the target is affected by Flame Shock and its damage is increased by your critical strike chance.

51514.name: Hex

51564.description:
Casting Riptide grants 1 stack of Tidal Waves. Tidal Waves reduces the cast time of your next Healing Wave or Chain Heal by 20%.

Can accumulate up to 2 stacks.
51564.name: Tidal Waves

51690.description:
Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point.

Restores 1 combo point every 0.45 sec.

   1 point  : 195 over 0.45 sec
   2 points: 293 over 0.89 sec
   3 points: 390 over 1.34 sec
   4 points: 488 over 1.78 sec
   5 points: 585 over 2.23 sec
51690.name: Killing Spree

51723.description:
Sprays knives at all enemies within 8 yards, dealing 37 Physical damage and applying your active poisons at their normal rate. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Awards 1 combo point.
51723.name: Fan of Knives

5176.description: Hurl a ball of energy at the target, dealing 229 Nature damage.
5176.name: Wrath

51886.description: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.
51886.name: Cleanse Spirit

5211.description: Invokes the spirit of Ursoc to stun the target for 4 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
5211.name: Mighty Bash

52127.description:
The caster is surrounded by globes of water, granting 15 mana per 5 sec. When a melee attack hits the caster, the caster regains 2% of their mana. This effect can only occur once every 3 sec. 

Only one of your Elemental Shields can be active on you at once.
52127.name: Water Shield

5217.description: Instantly restores 50 Energy, and increases the damage of all your attacks by 15% for their full duration. Lasts 10 sec.
5217.name: Tiger's Fury

5221.description:
Shred the target, causing 75 Physical damage to the target.

Awards 1 combo point.
5221.name: Shred

52212.description: Corrupts the ground targeted by the Death Knight, causing Shadow damage every sec that targets remain in the area for 10 sec.
52212.name: Death and Decay

5225.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.
5225.name: Track Humanoids

5246.description:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.
5246.name: Intimidating Shout

527.description: Dispels harmful effects on the target, removing all Magic effects.
527.name: Purify

5277.description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
5277.name: Evasion

528.description: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
528.name: Dispel Magic

53.description:
Stab the target, causing 38 Physical damage. Damage increased by 20% when you are behind your target.

Awards 1 combo point.
53.name: Backstab

53140.description: Teleports you to Dalaran in Northrend.
53140.name: Teleport: Dalaran - Northrend

53142.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Dalaran.
53142.name: Portal: Dalaran - Northrend

53351.description: You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 245 Physical damage. Only usable on enemies with less than 20% health.
53351.name: Kill Shot

53376.description: Avenging Wrath and Avenging Crusader have 25% increased duration.
53376.name: Sanctified Wrath

53385.description:
Unleashes a whirl of divine energy, dealing 66 Holy damage to all nearby enemies. 

Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
53385.name: Divine Storm

Instructs your pet to protect a friendly target, reducing their damage taken by 15%, but 50% of all damage taken by that target is transferred to your pet. 

Lasts 10 sec or until your pet's health drops below 25%.
53480.name: Roar of Sacrifice

53576.description:
Your Holy Shocks have a 10% chance to empower your next spell cast:

Flash of Light: healing increased by 200% and becomes instant cast.
Judgment: Greater Judgment prevents an additional 150% damage dealt by the target and generates 1 additional Holy Power.
53576.name: Infusion of Light

53595.description:
Hammers the current target for 52 Physical damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
53595.name: Hammer of the Righteous

53600.description: Slams enemies in front of you with your shield, causing 33 Holy damage, and increasing your Armor by 608 for 4.5 sec.
53600.name: Shield of the Righteous

53652.description: Wrap a single ally in holy energy, causing your direct healing on other party or raid members to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.
53652.name: Beacon of Light

5374.description:
Instantly attacks for 41 Physical damage.

Awards 1 combo point.
5374.name: Mutilate

5384.description: Feign death, tricking enemies into ignoring you. Lasts up to 6 min.
5384.name: Feign Death

5394.description:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 254 every 1.8 sec.

If you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.
5394.name: Healing Stream Totem

546.description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Damage will cancel the effect.
546.name: Water Walking

5484.description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
5484.name: Howl of Terror

5487.description:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
5487.name: Bear Form

5502.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
5502.name: Sense Undead

55078.description: A shadowy disease that drains 93 health from the target over 24 sec.
55078.name: Blood Plague

55090.description:
An unholy strike that deals 46 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
55090.name: Scourge Strike

55095.description: A disease that deals 59 Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.
55095.name: Frost Fever

55233.description: Embrace your undeath, increasing your maximum health by 30% and increasing all healing and absorbs received by 30% for 10 sec.
55233.name: Vampiric Blood

55342.description:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate
55342.name: Mirror Image

556.description: Yanks you through the twisting nether back to your inn. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.
556.name: Astral Recall

556606.description: Lightbearer's healing transfer is increased by up to 150% based on your current health. Lower health heals allies for more.
556606.name: Luminescence

55676.description: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
55676.name: Petrifying Scream

56222.description: Command the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.
56222.name: Dark Command

56244.description: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
56244.name: Horrify

56377.description: Your Flurry and Frostbolt spells strike 1 additional target at 80% effectiveness.
56377.name: Splitting Ice

56641.description:
A steady shot that causes 111 Physical damage.

Usable while moving.

Generates 20 Focus.
56641.name: Steady Shot

56814.description: Focus intently on trying to detect certain creatures.
56814.name: Detection

5697.description: Allows an ally to breathe underwater and increases swim speed by 20% for 10 min.
5697.name: Unending Breath

5740.description:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 1,395 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
5740.name: Rain of Fire

5761.description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.
5761.name: Numbing Poison

57755.description: Throws your weapon at the enemy, causing 12 Physical damage. Generates high threat.
57755.name: Heroic Throw

5782.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, disorienting for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.
5782.name: Fear

5784.description: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount.
5784.name: Felsteed

57934.description: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
57934.name: Tricks of the Trade

57994.description: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.
57994.name: Wind Shear

58423.description: Your finishing moves generate 5 Energy per combo point spent.
58423.name: Relentless Strikes

585.description: Smites an enemy for 372 Holy damage.
585.name: Smite

586.description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.
586.name: Fade

58875.description: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.
58875.name: Spirit Walk

589.description: A word of darkness that causes 64 Shadow damage instantly, and an additional 424 Shadow damage over 16 sec.
589.name: Shadow Word: Pain

59057.description: Frost Strike and Glacial Advance have a 45% chance to cause your next Howling Blast to consume no runes and deal 275% additional damage.
59057.name: Rime

5938.description:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
5938.name: Shiv

596.description: A powerful prayer that heals your target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,230.
596.name: Prayer of Healing

60103.description:
Charges your off-hand weapon with lava and burns your target, dealing 4 Fire damage.

Damage is increased by 100% if your offhand weapon is imbued with Flametongue Weapon.
60103.name: Lava Lash

60188.description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 250% damage instead of the usual 200%.
60188.name: Elemental Fury

605.description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.
605.name: Mind Control

61295.description: Restorative waters wash over a friendly target, healing them for 1,818 and an additional 1,018 over 18 sec.
61295.name: Riptide

61329.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 16%.
61329.name: Combat Potency

61336.description: Reduces all damage you take by 50% for 6 sec.
61336.name: Survival Instincts

61648.description: The Hunter takes on the aspect of a chameleon, becoming untrackable.
61648.name: Aspect of the Chameleon

6196.description: Changes your viewpoint to the targeted location for 1 min.
6196.name: Far Sight

6197.description: Changes your viewpoint to the targeted location for 1 min. Only usable outdoors.
6197.name: Eagle Eye

61999.name: Raise Ally

62618.description: Summons a holy barrier to protect all allies at the target location for 10 sec, reducing all damage taken by 20% and preventing damage from delaying spellcasting.
62618.name: Power Word: Barrier

633.description:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
633.name: Lay on Hands

6343.description:
Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

If you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.
6343.name: Thunder Clap

6353.description:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 10,170 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.
6353.name: Soul Fire

64129.description: Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.
64129.name: Body and Soul

642.description:
Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. 

Cannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
642.name: Divine Shield

64382.description: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 214 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
64382.name: Shattering Throw

64843.description:
Heals all party or raid members within 40 yards for 10,680 over 4.5 sec. Each heal increases all targets' healing taken by 4% for 15 sec, stacking.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
64843.name: Divine Hymn

6544.description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
6544.name: Heroic Leap

6552.name: Pummel

Swing in a wide arc, dealing 84 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Your successful dodges and parries have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage.
6572.name: Revenge

66.description: Turns you invisible over 3 sec, reducing threat each second. While invisible, you are untargetable by enemies. Lasts 20 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

66235.description:
Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.

While Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.
66235.name: Ardent Defender

6673.description: Increases the attack power of all raid and party members within 100 yards by 5% for 1 hour.
6673.name: Battle Shout

6770.description: Incapacitates a target not in combat for 1 min. Only works on Humanoids, Beasts, Demons, and Dragonkin. Damage will revive the target. Limit 1.
6770.name: Sap

6789.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.
6789.name: Mortal Coil

6795.description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

6807.description: Maul the target for 76 Physical damage.

686.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 651 Shadow damage.

691.description: Summons a Felhunter under your command, able to disrupt the spell casts of your enemies.
691.name: Summon Felhunter

6940.description:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.

Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.
6940.name: Blessing of Sacrifice

697.name: Summon Voidwalker

69826.description: Summons a Great Sunwalker Kodo, which serves as a mount.
69826.name: Summon Great Sunwalker Kodo

6991.name: Feed Pet

702.description:
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

703.description:
Garrote the enemy, causing 159 Bleed damage over 18 sec.

Awards 1 combo point.

73630.description: Summons an Great Exarch's Elekk, which serves as a mount.

73685.name: Unleash Life

Healing decreased beyond 5 targets.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

77130.name: Purify Spirit

772.description: Lash out with your weapon, striking all targets within 10 yds for 92 Physical damage instantly and wounding them for an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.

77472.description: An efficient wave of healing energy that restores 5,105 of a friendly target’s health.

Causes the earth within 8 yards of the target location to tremble and break, dealing 1,460 Nature damage over 6 sec and has a 5% chance to knock the enemy down. Multiple uses of Earthquake may overlap.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
77478.name: Earthquake

77575.description:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 153 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for 64 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 70 Shadow damage over 24 sec.
77575.name: Outbreak

77606.description: Places a dark ward on an enemy player that persists for 12 sec, triggering when the enemy next spends mana on a spell, and allowing the Death Knight to unleash an exact duplicate of that spell.
77606.name: Dark Simulacrum

77756.description: Flame Shock periodic damage has a chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Lava Burst and cause your next Lava Burst to be instant.
77756.name: Lava Surge

77758.description:
Strikes all nearby enemies, dealing 33 Bleed damage and an additional 12 Bleed damage over 15 sec. When applied from Bear Form, this effect can stack up to 3 times.

Generates 5 Rage.
77758.name: Thrash

783.description:
Shapeshift into a travel form appropriate to your current location, increasing movement speed on land, in water, or in the air, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
783.name: Travel Form

78674.description: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 1,338 Astral damage.
78674.name: Starsurge

78675.description: Summons a beam of solar light over an enemy target's location, interrupting the target and silencing all enemies within the beam. Lasts 8 sec.
78675.name: Solar Beam

79008.description: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
79008.name: Elusiveness

79134.description:
You regain 3 Energy each time your Garrote or Rupture deal Bleed damage to a target affected by your weapon poisons. Energy gain is reduced for bleeds beyond the first.

If an enemy dies while afflicted by your Rupture, you regain energy based on its remaining duration.
79134.name: Venomous Wounds

79206.description: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.
79206.name: Spiritwalker's Grace

79684.description: Casting Arcane spells has a 10% chance to grant access to Arcane Missiles or make your next Arcane Explosion free.
79684.name: Clearcasting

8004.description: A quick surge of healing energy that restores 4,164 of a friendly target's health.
8004.name: Healing Surge

80240.description: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 60% of the damage dealt.
80240.name: Havoc

80353.description:
Warp the flow of time, increasing haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.

Allies will be unable to benefit from Bloodlust, Heroism, or Time Warp again for 10 min.
80353.name: Time Warp

8042.description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 3,011 Nature damage.
8042.name: Earth Shock

8092.description: Blast the target's mind for 301 Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.
8092.name: Mind Blast

81136.description: Your auto attacks on targets infected with your Blood Plague have a chance to make your next Death and Decay cost no runes and reset its cooldown.
81136.name: Crimson Scourge

8122.description: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.
8122.name: Psychic Scream

81269.description: Restores 217 health to three injured allies within 10 yards of the initial target every 1.8 sec for 30 sec.
81269.name: Efflorescence

81297.description: Deals 1 Holy damage every 0.9 sec to enemies within 8 yards.
81297.name: Consecration

8143.description: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.
8143.name: Tremor Totem

81749.description:
Power Word: Shield, Flash Heal, Plea, Penance, and Power Word: Radiance apply Atonement to your target for 15 sec.

Your spell damage heals all targets affected by Atonement for 30% of the damage done. Healing is reduced when healing more than 5 targets.
81749.name: Atonement

82326.description: A powerful but expensive spell, healing a friendly target for 12,442.
82326.name: Holy Light

83242.description: Summons your second pet to you.
83242.name: Call Pet 2

83243.description: Summons your third pet to you.
83243.name: Call Pet 3

83244.description: Summons your fourth pet to you.
83244.name: Call Pet 4

83245.description: Summons your fifth pet to you.
83245.name: Call Pet 5

845.description: Strikes all enemies in front of you for 90 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
845.name: Cleave

84714.description:
Launches an orb of swirling ice in front of you, dealing up to 5,574 Frost damage to all enemies it passes through over 15 sec. After a short delay, Frozen Orb will pursue its target. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enemies damaged by the Frozen Orb are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.
84714.name: Frozen Orb

85043.description: When you avoid a melee attack or use Crusader Strike, you have a 15% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Avenger's Shield.
85043.name: Grand Crusader

85222.description: Unleashes Holy energy, healing up to 5 injured allies within a 40 yd radius around you for 1,925.
85222.name: Light of Dawn

85256.description: Unleashes a powerful weapon strike that deals 61 Holy damage to an enemy target.
85256.name: Templar's Verdict

85288.description:
A mighty blow with both weapons that deals a total of 77 Physical damage.

Generates 12 Rage.
85288.name: Raging Blow

85384.description:
A mighty blow with both weapons that deals a total of 77 Physical damage.

Generates 12 Rage.
85384.name: Raging Blow

85673.description: Calls down the Light to heal a friendly target for 1,604.
85673.name: Word of Glory

85948.description:
Slash the enemy for 70 Physical damage and corrupt your weapon with blight, causing your next 2-3 Scourge Strikes to summon a Lesser Ghoul.

Lesser Ghoul
A mindless servant of the Scourge, raised to obey its master's commands for 6 sec.
85948.name: Festering Strike

86392.description: Your main-hand attacks have a 30% chance to trigger an attack with your off-hand that deals 0 Physical damage.
86392.name: Main Gauche

86659.description: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.
86659.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings

86678.description: Heals the target of your heals for 30% of the amount healed.
86678.name: Light of the Ancient Kings

86704.description: Unleash the fury of ancient kings, causing 10 Holy damage per application of Ancient Power, divided evenly among all targets within 10 yards.
86704.name: Ancient Fury

8676.description:
Ambush the target, causing 96 Physical damage.

Awards 2 combo points.
8676.name: Ambush

8679.description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, which instantly inflicts 1 Nature damage and reduces all healing received by 8% for 12 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
8679.name: Wound Poison

86949.description:
Fatal damage instead brings you to 35% health and then burns you for 28% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

While burning, movement slowing effects are suppressed and your movement speed is increased by 150%.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 min.
86949.name: Cauterize

871.description: Reduces all damage you take by 40% for 8 sec.
871.name: Shield Wall

88163.description: Starts combat by attacking a target with a melee weapon.
88163.name: Attack

883.description: Summons your first pet to you.
883.name: Call Pet 1

88345.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Tol Barad.
88345.name: Portal: Tol Barad

88423.description: Cures harmful effects on the friendly target, removing all Magic effects.
88423.name: Nature's Cure

88625.description: Chastises the target for 1,486 Holy damage and incapacitates them for 4 sec.
88625.name: Holy Word: Chastise

88747.description:
Grow a magical mushroom at the target enemy's location. After 1 sec, the mushroom detonates, dealing 1,211 Nature damage and then an additional 684 Nature damage over 10 sec. Affected targets are slowed by 50%.

Generates up to 20 Astral Power based on targets hit.
88747.name: Wild Mushroom

8921.description: A quick beam of lunar light burns the enemy for 80 Arcane damage and then an additional 705 Arcane damage over 18 sec.
8921.name: Moonfire

8936.description: Heals a friendly target for 1,996 and another 287 over 6 sec.
8936.name: Regrowth

91023.description: Your Stealth abilities allow you to see the flaws in enemies' defenses, causing your attacks to ignore 30% armor for 10 sec.
91023.name: Find Weakness

93322.description: Allows you to give commands to control your pet.
93322.name: Control Pet

93375.description: Summons a Voidwalker under your command, able to withstand heavy punishment.
93375.name: Control Demon

93402.description: A quick beam of solar light burns the enemy for 82 Nature damage and then an additional 705 Nature damage over 18 sec.
93402.name: Sunfire

936051.description: The light reveals all enemies in stealth or invisible to you while under the effects of Divine Shield. This effect lingers for 20 sec after Divine Shield fades.
936051.name: Shining Revelation

94289.description: Casting a targeted heal on any target, except yourself, also heals you for 20.
94289.name: Protector of the Innocent

9484.description: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.
9484.name: Shackle Horror

95738.description: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, striking all nearby targets with your off-hand weapon for 5 Physical damage.
95738.name: Bladestorm Off-Hand

96231.description: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
96231.name: Rebuke

974.description:
Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for 332 when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.

Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.
974.name: Earth Shield

97462.description:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.
97462.name: Rallying Cry

980.description:
Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 2,379 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

Agony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.
980.name: Agony

98008.description: Summons a totem at the target location for 6 sec, which reduces damage taken by all party and raid members within 10 yards by 10%. Immediately and every 1 sec, the health of all affected players is redistributed evenly.
98008.name: Spirit Link Totem

982.description: Revives your pet, returning it to life with 100% of its base health.
982.name: Revive Pet

99.description: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
99.name: Incapacitating Roar
